description: Querying, relationships, saved views, export and bulk selection

rows.feature: Record list renders metadata labels and all records in the default primary-key-descending order
rows.fixture: QueryFixtures.java qryItem (8 rows, every field type)
scenarios: Headers use field labels
Rows equal SQL select ordered by id desc
Possible-value cells show labels, booleans Yes/No, money/decimals formatted
negative: Null boolean renders empty, not No
Hidden and heavy (TEXT) fields are not columns

rows.feature: Pagination with Material page sizes and URL state
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) carrier (11 rows)
scenarios: Page 2 shows the remaining rows
Page and size survive reload via URL
negative: Next is disabled on the last page

rows.feature: Column header sort cycles ascending, descending and default; sort kept in the URL
scenarios: Ascending and descending match SQL order by
Sort persists across reload
negative: Third click returns to the PK-descending default

rows.feature: Column visibility and order persist per table
scenarios: Hide/show and reorder columns
Order and visibility survive reload
Show/hide all per table group
negative: Another table keeps its own columns

rows.feature: Column widths, density and card view
scenarios: Resized width persists
Density changes row height
Card view shows the same records
negative: Keyboard resize separator exposes its value

rows.feature: Opening a record and returning keeps the query; refresh shows backend changes
scenarios: Filter, sort and page are restored after Back
Refresh shows a row changed through the API
negative: No stale cached rows after refresh

rows.feature: A failed query reports the backend error with a retry
scenarios: Backend error text shown
Retry reloads after the failure clears
negative: No rows from the failed request are shown

rows.feature: Text operators match Material labels and backend semantics
scenarios: equals, does not equal, contains, starts/ends with, is any of, is like, is empty/not empty; results equal SQL
negative: does not equal includes empty values (NOT_EQUALS_OR_IS_NULL)
Incomplete criteria are not sent

rows.feature: Number operators including ranges and lists
scenarios: equals, greater/less (or equal), is between, is any of; results equal SQL
Values sent as numbers
negative: not between and none of exclude the bounds/list

rows.feature: Date operators and relative date expressions
scenarios: is/after/before/between with dates
today, N days ago, start of this/last month send backend expression JSON and match SQL
negative: Clearing an expression restores a plain value input

rows.feature: Date-time operators convert local input to UTC and support relative values
scenarios: Local input sent as UTC instant
now and N hours ago expressions match SQL
negative: Grid shows formatted date-times, not raw ISO

rows.feature: Boolean, blob and long-text operators
scenarios: equals yes / equals no / is empty for booleans
blob is empty / not empty
long text contains
negative: Blob offers no value operators

rows.feature: Possible-value selectors for table and enum sources show labels and send ids
scenarios: is / is any of / is none of with label chips
Link-loaded ids render labels
Results equal SQL
negative: Search with no match shows no options

rows.feature: AND/OR and nested groups combine as declared
scenarios: AND group, OR group and nested subfilter match SQL
negative: Removing the last criterion clears the filter

rows.feature: Filters live in the URL: reload, back/forward and Material-style JSON links
scenarios: Reload keeps the filter
Back/forward switches filters
Plain JSON filter link opens filtered
negative: Malformed filter param falls back to no filter

rows.feature: Backend-only operators from links render and filter correctly
scenarios: Each operator from a link renders its label and returns the SQL rows
negative: FALSE matches no records; builder does not crash

rows.feature: Quick search combines with the advanced filter
scenarios: Search term ANDs with Is Active = yes
negative: Clearing search restores the filtered rows

rows.feature: One-side exposed join: labelled columns, filters and sorts match SQL
scenarios: Join column 'Owner: First Name' hidden by default, shown on demand
Join filter and sort match SQL LEFT JOIN
negative: Joins only sent when used; rows without a match are kept

rows.feature: Many-side exposed join repeats rows and reports the distinct count
scenarios: Repeated rows per note
Count shows (N distinct)
negative: Row selection dedupes repeated ids

rows.feature: Column statistics aggregate the filtered rows
scenarios: Value distribution and count/distinct/sum/avg/min/max equal SQL under the filter
negative: Sort by value/count

rows.feature: Tables without QUERY_STATS offer no column statistics
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) person
scenarios: No statistics button on headers
negative: Process not launched

rows.feature: Selection menu: this page, full query result, first N, clear
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) carrier
scenarios: Banners and counts for page, all and subset
negative: Subset dialog rejects invalid N

rows.feature: Bulk Edit launches with the checked record ids
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) carrier
scenarios: recordIds param equals checked rows
negative: No selection shows 'No records were selected to Bulk Edit.'

rows.feature: Bulk Delete of the full query result sends the whole filter
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) carrier (page 2)
scenarios: filterJSON has no skip/limit; backend recordCount equals SQL count
negative: Current page paging is not sent

rows.feature: First-N selection under a filter launches with that limit
scenarios: filterJSON limit N with the filter and sort
negative: N larger than the result is capped

rows.feature: Actions menu offers bulk load, bulk processes and table processes
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) person
scenarios: Bulk Load/Edit/Edit With File/Delete then table processes
Launch carries the selection
negative: Process min/max record checks block launch with a message

rows.feature: Viewers get no create, bulk or process actions and the backend refuses them
rows.fixture: viewer persona on sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies)
scenarios: No Create, bulk or write process entries
negative: Direct insert/delete API calls return 403

rows.feature: CSV export has visible columns in order and exactly the filtered, sorted rows
scenarios: File name, headers and rows equal SQL
Join columns exported
negative: Hidden columns excluded

rows.feature: XLSX and JSON exports carry the same rows
scenarios: XLSX sheet and JSON array equal SQL rows
negative: JSON keys limited to exported fields

rows.feature: Nothing to export disables the formats
scenarios: Empty filter result disables CSV/XLSX/JSON
negative: No export request sent

rows.feature: Backend refuses exports of unreadable tables
scenarios: Export of a readable table succeeds
negative: Export of pet returns 403 without data

rows.feature: Your saved views are listed and open on their own route
scenarios: 'Your Saved Views' lists backend views
/savedView/{id} applies filter/columns
negative: Empty group message

rows.feature: Saving a new view stores filter, sort, columns and page size
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) person
scenarios: saved_view row viewJson matches Material RecordQueryView
negative: Unsaved-changes indicator clears after save

rows.feature: Update, rename and delete your view
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) person
scenarios: Update keeps unrelated view JSON
Rename and delete change the saved_view row
negative: Reset All Changes restores the stored view

rows.feature: Duplicate names and unknown views are reported without changes
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) person
scenarios: Duplicate name error shown in the dialog
negative: Unknown view id shows an error; saved_view unchanged

rows.feature: A view shared with you opens read-only and the backend refuses changes
rows.fixture: QueryFixtures.java (Alice People View shared with sample:bob READ_ONLY)
scenarios: Listed under 'Views Shared with you' for bob
Opens with its filter
negative: Owner-only actions disabled; storeSavedView by bob refused

rows.feature: Variant table asks for a variant, queries with it and remembers it
scenarios: Picker lists /variants
Rows equal the chosen store
Choice remembered and changeable; export uses it
negative: Filter narrows options

rows.feature: Dismissing the variant prompt queries nothing; backend requires a variant
scenarios: Prompt shown with a choose button
negative: No query sent; API query without a variant fails

rows.feature: A table without count, export or write capabilities offers none of them
scenarios: Rows listed without a total
Export disabled with explanation
No create or bulk actions
negative: Backend insert refused

rows.feature: Enum-backed Pet Species table is read-only
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) petSpecies
scenarios: Metadata omits write capabilities; no Create or bulk writes
negative: Insert returns 403, not 500

rows.feature: Backend refuses count and export for a table without those capabilities
scenarios: Query still succeeds
negative: v1 count, legacy count and export return 403

rows.feature: Processes launched from a variant table run with the chosen variant (tableVariant on init and every step) and return to the query
rows.fixture: QueryFixtures.java qryStock (memory backend keyed by qryStore variants)
scenarios: Bulk Delete of the South store's full query result counts its one record
Every init and step request carries tableVariant {type: qryStore, id: 2}
Return comes back to the variant query, which is empty for South while North keeps its two rows
negative: Without the variant the backend could not read the variant table's records

rows.feature: Possible-value cells show the related record label and link to it
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) pet.personId
scenarios: Owner cell shows the person label
Link opens /app/person/{id}
negative: Enum values are not links

rows.feature: Parent lists exactly its own children; View All opens the filtered child list
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) person -> pets
scenarios: Panel rows equal SQL children
View All filters /app/pet and Back returns
negative: Parent without children shows an empty panel

rows.feature: Adding a child from its parent links it and shows it immediately
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) person -> pets
scenarios: New pet stored with person_id of the parent
Panel refreshes
negative: Join field not editable; no other rows changed

rows.feature: Three-level associations: each pet shows only its own notes
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) person -> pet -> petNote
scenarios: Notes equal SQL per pet
negative: Other pets' notes absent

rows.feature: Editing and deleting a child leaves no stale parent, list or unexpected rows
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) pet, petNote
scenarios: Renamed pet shown in parent panel and list
Deleting a pet removes its notes
negative: Other rows unchanged

rows.feature: Denied child reads show an unavailable panel without data or actions
rows.fixture: noPets persona; qryShelter whose associated qryShelterPet is denied with DenyBehavior.DISABLED
scenarios: Panel says related records are unavailable
negative: No data, View All or Create; API query 403

rows.feature: Aliased and composite associations bind to their widgets and list the right members
rows.fixture: QueryFixtures.java qryHousehold/qryMember (members, care group / primary, scheduled reviews)
scenarios: childRecordList and rowBuilder show SQL-matching members
Composite join on code + review date
negative: Household without members shows empty

rows.feature: Adding through a composite association stores every join value
scenarios: New member stored with household_code and review_date from the parent
negative: Aliased association unaffected; other rows unchanged

rows.feature: Deleting a parent removes associated children and leaves other parents intact
rows.fixture: sample (person, pet, petNote, carrier, petSpecies) person -> pets
scenarios: Person and its pets removed
negative: Other pets and notes unchanged; list reflects SQL
